description: Thin React wrapper over the raw @rive-app/webgl2 runtime: one Rive instance per mount, destroyed on unmount, drawing surface resized to the measured box via ResizeObserver. 11 .riv files ship in public/assets/rive/.

aspectRatio.note: CSS aspect-ratio on the wrapper box, e.g. "1344/573"

notes: The wasm binary is resolved out of the installed package via a Vite `?url` import rather than the unpkg URL the original uses, so the clone makes no third-party runtime request. The runtime’s own jsdelivr fallback stays in place.
Rive scenes are opaque binaries; they cannot be regenerated. See assetRole motion.rive-scene (must-reuse-exact).
